annotations.exact_quote: Non-Negative Matrix Factorization With Locality Constrained Adaptive Graph
annotations.reason_zh: 标题直接给出论文以非负矩阵分解为核心方法，摘要也提出NMF-LCAG算法。

annotations.exact_quote: two locality constraint terms are employed in our NMF-LCAG to adaptively optimize the graph
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确通过局部约束项自适应优化图，并同时学习图的权重矩阵，符合学习或修正样本间亲和图结构。

annotations.exact_quote: the proposed algorithm introduces a locality constrained graph to discover the latent manifold structure of the data
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要说明引入局部约束图以发现数据潜在流形结构，并用图正则化NMF施加几何一致性约束。

annotations.exact_quote: low dimensional features of data can be simultaneously learned by our algorithm
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确算法同时学习数据的低维特征，属于显式低维嵌入与维度压缩。

annotations.exact_quote: Thus, the weight matrix of graph and low dimensional features of data can be simultaneously learned by our algorithm
annotations.reason_zh: 核心非负矩阵分解同时学习低维因子特征，显式采用低维矩阵分解表示数据结构；非负矩阵分解没有声明的父子关系，遗漏低秩建模。
